# ARIS (Auto-Research-In-Sleep) — third-party skill bundle

**Source:** https://github.com/wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep (14,553★, arXiv:2605.03042)
**Staged:** 2026-08-11 (QWAV.PLT.002.P5) — git-tracked only; NOT activated.
**Activation:** SKILL-FILE-NE-INSTALLED-1 — files on disk do NOT register with the app loader.
Use the app’s Skills install flow (Settings → Skills) to activate individual skills from this bundle.
**Contents:** 90 markdown-only research skills (arxiv, alphaxiv, deepxiv, semantic-scholar, auto-review-loop,
idea-discovery, novelty-check, citation-audit, paper-write, proof-checker, rebuttal, etc.)
